channel.title: Lake & McHenry County Scanner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lake & McHenry County Scanner (lakemchenryscanner.com)

item.title: Suspect in custody after allegedly attempting to murder woman found critically injured in Beach Park
item.description: Deputies have arrested a suspect who they say attempted to murder a woman who was found unresponsive and rushed to the hospital in critical condition in Beach Park Friday afternoon.

item.title: 1 hospitalized after crash leaves car lodged underneath semi-tractor-trailer truck on I-294 near Deerfield
item.description: One person was transported to the hospital with injuries after an SUV crashed into a semi-tractor-trailer truck, with the car becoming lodged underneath the trailer, on Interstate 294 near Deerfield.

item.title: Child hospitalized with moderate injuries after ATV rolls over off roadway in Wonder Lake
item.description: A child was hospitalized with moderate injuries after he lost control of his ATV and it rolled over off the roadway in Wonder Lake, fire officials said.

item.title: Trump and Truth Store hosts soft opening of new store in Crystal Lake after closure of Huntley location
item.description: The owner of the Trump Truth Store in Huntley, which was closed down in July following an eviction case, launched her new retail store in Crystal Lake with a soft opening Saturday.

item.title: Army recruiter assigned to Lake County office accused of soliciting, grooming student from Fox Lake
item.description: Police say a U.S. Army recruiter assigned to the Army's office in Round Lake Beach was arrested for allegedly soliciting and grooming a child student from Fox Lake.

item.title: 2 hospitalized, including 1 extricated from SUV after 3-car crash in Round Lake
item.description: Two people were hospitalized, including one who was trapped and had to be extricated by firefighters, after three cars crashed in Round Lake Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Deputies arrest suspect accused of burglarizing cars, stealing gun and car before fleeing police in Port Barrington
item.description: Deputies have arrested a suspect who they say broke into vehicles in Port Barrington, stole a gun from a car and then stole a car and fled from deputies, leading to an hours-long search in Port Barrington.

item.title: Man injured while trying to extinguish fire that broke out in living room of house near Harvard
item.description: A man suffered smoke inhalation while trying to extinguish a fire that broke out in the living room of a house near Harvard Saturday evening, fire officials said.

item.title: Clipper system to bring more snow Sunday as arctic temperatures move into Chicagoland area
item.description: A clipper system will bring steady and fluffy snow to the Chicagoland area Sunday afternoon into the evening as an arctic front brings wind chills 20-25 degrees below zero.

item.title: 'A very sad day': Massive fire department sent after extra-alarm fire tears through bakery in downtown McHenry
item.description: A massive, multi-county fire department response was dispatched to a multi-alarm fire that broke out at Riverside Bake Shop and Reese's Barkery in downtown McHenry Sunday afternoon.
